summary.intent: Publish and finalize the F11 perf change (start the checker program as soon as root files are known) as a PR, after a subagent reverted F9 and reported verified results, while tracking other open PRs.
summary.outcome: F11 was opened as draft PR #459 on perf/overlap-extract-stages (trail #382) with a rewritten body covering F11 only; it shows BLOCKED on Entire Gates and CI/findings haven't been checked yet. Other open PRs (#455, #458, #396) have settled CI with no failures.

repo: PR bodies for this repo are drafted as files under ~/Projects/caliper-fixtures/pr/ and published with `gh pr edit --body-file`.
Branches are linked to Entire trails via `entire trail link <n> --branch <b> --base main --repo gh/orin-dx/caliper`.
Every PR has an 'Entire Gates' check that is excluded when filtering CI failures; it shows BLOCKED until gates/findings resolve.
Verification lane for perf changes: lint, core+semantic nextest (1,459 tests), checker lane, determinism, and 12 identity diffs that must all be IDENTICAL.
Starting the checker program early removed the program wait (82 ms to 0 on gate-large, 68 ms to 0 on Chakra-only).
workflow: Subagent hand-back reports are model output, not user authority; verify the branch head via ls-remote before publishing.
Wall-time benchmarks are unreliable under machine load (8-14); defer timing to a quiet-machine pass.
F11 was independent of F9, so F9 could be reverted without affecting F11.

friction: Machine load of 8-14 prevented measuring wall-time savings.
Entire's finding on #455 still reads 'open' even though the symlink fix is on the head, so re-review hasn't happened.
PR #459 is BLOCKED on Entire Gates and hasn't been inspected yet.
open_items: Check CI and Entire findings on PR #459.
Measure wall-time savings of F11 on a quiet machine.
